Work was carried out with several developers of social housing in Mexico, with the dual purpose of (1) proposing a sustainability scheme in housing that is cost-effective for businesses and their people, achieving high energy efficiency and improving environmental performance; and (2) quantify the benefits in terms of energy savings and mitigation of greenhouse gasses that the sector’s actions have had and will have in the future.
